name: swarmery-link
description: Mod (function hooks): reports this session's live state (turn start and end, tool calls by name and input hash, context fill, rate limits, cost) to a local swarmery daemon over its token-guarded link API, and switches itself off when the daemon's token file is absent. The sensor never blocks, changes or answers a hook's event. With the opt-in control option it also long-polls the daemon for this session's commands: stop aborts the running turn, prompt submits a prompt once the session is idle.

control.title: Control from the dashboard
control.description: Let the swarmery dashboard stop this session's running turn and send it prompts. One background loop long-polls the daemon (loopback only, bearer token) for commands queued for this session alone; nothing runs inside a hook and no gating hook is registered. Off: no request goes to the command endpoints.

planBand.title: Plan band
planBand.description: Reserved for a later release (a band above the prompt showing the running plan). In 0.2 it only logs that it is not implemented.

swarm.title: Swarm view
swarm.description: Reserved for a later release (sibling sessions of the same plan). In 0.2 it only logs that it is not implemented.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.description: Reserved for a later release (the plan's forecast beside the live figures). In 0.2 it only logs that it is not implemented.

daemonUrl.title: Daemon URL
daemonUrl.description: The daemon's REST origin. Loopback http only (127.0.0.1, [::1] or localhost, any port); any other value is refused and the default is used, so the token never leaves the machine.
